Name: Stardew Tinder
Author: DevSopia
Description:
[b]StardewTinder[/b] brings a fully functional dating app into your farmer's phone! Inspired by modern swipe-based apps, this mod lets you browse profiles of Pelican Town's most eligible (and not-so-eligible) bachelors and bachelorettes — including a few married villagers with suspiciously blank profile pictures.
Swipe right to like, left to pass, or use a [b]Super Like[/b] to guarantee attention. Build your [b]reputation[/b] to increase match chances, manage a jealousy system between social groups, and unlock story arcs as you chat with your matches.
[quote][b]Note:[/b] This is a [b]BETA[/b] release. The definitive version featuring a fully reworked UI layout, redesigned HUD, expanded dialogue system, and more customization options is coming soon. Stay tuned![/quote][line]
[b]Installation instructions:[/b]


[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [b]SMAPI[/b] installed (version 4.0 or newer).[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game once to generate the
[code]config.json[/code]file.[/*]
[*]Press the [b]T[/b] key (configurable) to open the app on your phone.[/*]
[*]That's it — start swiping![/*]
[/list][b]Main features:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Swipe System[/b] — Browse NPC profiles with portraits, ages, and custom bios. Filter by gender preference.[/*]
[*][b]Match & Chat[/b] — Matched NPCs appear in your inbox. Chat with dialogue choices that affect friendship.[/*]
[*][b]Reputation System[/b] — Your behavior affects your profile tier (from [i]Flagged[/i] to [i]Verified[/i]). Too many rejections in a row will hurt your score![/*]
[*][b]Super Like[/b] — One per day. Guarantees a match regardless of RNG.[/*]
[*][b]Daily Notifications[/b] — Matched NPCs may send you messages every morning.[/*]
[*][b]Jealousy System[/b] — Matching too many people from the same social group triggers friendship penalties.[/*]
[*][b]Story Arcs[/b] — Progress through 5 narrative levels per NPC with unique dialogue and item rewards.[/*]
[*][b]Scheduled Dates[/b] — Some chat options let you arrange in-game meetups.[/*]
[*][b]Achievements[/b] — Unlock titles like [i]Casanova[/i], [i]Heart of Stone[/i], and [i]Neighborhood Friend[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Player Profile[/b] — Choose your bio to subtly affect match chances.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Requirements:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] 1.6 or newer[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]No other mods required[/*]
[/list][line]
